fields.summary: the HTML display of containers with bnodes causes exceptions

comments.body:
given a container node (e.g. http://localhost:8080/fcrepo4/rest/foo)

issuing this command:
curl -XPATCH -H"Content-Type: application/sparql-update" --data-binary @bnode.txt localhost:8080/fcrepo4/rest/foo

creates the bnode. It can be retrieved via curl normally:

curl localhost:8080/fcrepo4/rest/foo

but if text/html is requested, it croaks:

curl localhost:8080/fcrepo4/rest/foo -H"Accept: text/html"

Also tested with nested blank nodes:
==============================
PREFIX dc: <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/>
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

INSERT

{ <> dc:creator [ a foaf:Person ; foaf:name "Me" ; foaf:homePage <http://example.com/> ; foaf:more [foaf:letters "aaa"; foaf:letters "bbb"; foaf:letters "ccc"]; ]. }

WHERE {}
==============================
Thanks for taking care of this, Andrew Woods.
This can be revisited if/when blank nodes are reworked.
